description: Library routine that copies a text string into a buffer, turning control and delete characters into spaces, converting lowercase letters to uppercase, and mapping the right bracket to a space. It stops at a double hash mark or after 100 characters, and places spaces at the end of the copied text.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0580

description: Library routine that writes a space character two bytes before an address held in an address register, then returns.

name: insert_vowel_stress_marker
description: Library routine that scans phonetic text for any of fifteen two-letter vowel codes from its reference table, and where one matches it inserts a digit 4 marker after the code, shifting the rest of the text along. It is the marking step in the translator's speech phoneme processing.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:05F2
name: insert_marker_shifting_buffer
description: Library routine that shifts the rest of a text buffer one place to the right, writes a digit 4 into the freed slot, and advances the stored buffer pointer. It is the insertion step used by the vowel marker routine.

name: wait_while_port_bit_set
description: Routine in the PAUSE file that busy-waits while bit six of the CIA port A register (CIAA_PRA) stays set, then returns. That register carries the fire buttons and disk status, so the loop waits on those input lines.

name: load_hunks_and_relocate
description: Main program startup routine that allocates memory for each code, data and uninitialised section, then reads the section type codes and applies the relocation records that patch addresses. It also asks the operating system for the current task and for memory, and the decompiled tail is unreliable.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:delphine:0:0112

name: count_register_down_loop
description: Program routine that counts a data register down until it passes through zero, then returns. It spends time in proportion to the starting value and touches no memory.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:delphine:0:015C
name: unpack_compressed_stream
description: Program routine that decodes a compressed byte stream, alternating between copying literal bytes forward and copying earlier output back along the destination buffer, with lengths read from the stream. Its references also include the background colour register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:delphine:0:01EA
name: decrement_byte_count_loop
description: Program routine that repeatedly decrements a byte held in a data register for a count taken from another register, replacing a zero value with a space as it goes. It makes no memory access and no calls.

description: Program fragment that the decompiler could not translate, so it holds only bad instruction data and no usable behaviour.

name: clear_state_block_then_dispatch
description: Entry routine for the add21k file that clears a block of twenty-three longwords, saves the start-up register, calls one routine only when a system flag bit is set, then branches on a result to one of two follow-on routines.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:0004
name: open_system_libraries_at_start
description: Start-up routine for the add21k file that opens the dos, graphics and intuition system libraries, raising an alert if one cannot be opened. It then walks a list of entries from the loaded structure and releases the libraries afterwards.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:0180
name: empty_return_stub
description: Routine that does nothing but return, so it is an empty stub in the add21k file with no observable work.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:0188
name: build_start_up_argument_list
description: Start-up routine that allocates a memory block for the program's data, copies the command line into it, and splits the line into words on spaces and tabs, keeping double-quoted text together. It also uses the dos library to read the current directory and the input and output handles.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:02C0
name: split_text_into_word_array
description: Routine that copies a program name into a newly allocated buffer, then splits the rest of a text line into words, keeping double-quoted text together. It builds a zero-terminated array of pointers to those words.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:0486
name: append_string_to_end
description: Appends one null-terminated text to the end of another, copying no more than about 32 thousand characters and ending the result with a zero byte. It returns the destination address.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:048E
name: append_string_with_count
description: Appends a null-terminated text onto the end of another, stopping once the count passed in the third argument is used up. When the copy is cut short it adds a zero byte, and it returns the destination address.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:04B2
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from a source to a destination up to a count or until a null terminator is found, then fills any remaining count with zeros. It is a bounded string copy that always fills the full count.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:04D4
name: load_window_icon_entry
description: Opens the icon library, looks up the entry named WINDOW and stores the two resulting pointers in the structure it is given, then closes the library. If any lookup fails, it stops at that point.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:0586
name: call_optional_handler_then_continue
description: Calls a stored handler through a pointer if one has been set, then calls another routine. It is a small optional-callback wrapper.

description: Calls a stored handler through a pointer if one has been set, then calls another routine. It is a small optional-callback wrapper.

name: release_allocated_resources
description: Teardown routine that frees each entry in a table of allocated blocks, releases the remaining buffers and resources it holds, and returns a result code. When bit four of a system flag is set, it enters supervisor mode through the operating system first.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:06C2
name: close_and_clear_file_slot
description: Closes the file held in a numbered slot of a table unless the slot's flag marks it as not owned, then clears the slot. It returns zero on success and minus one when the slot number is out of range or the slot is empty.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:073C
name: get_dos_output_handle
description: Library wrapper that loads the dos library base from a stored pointer and calls its output-handle function, passing back the result. It adds no logic of its own.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:076C
name: forward_stored_library_call
description: Tiny wrapper that loads a library base from a stored pointer and jumps to one library function through its vector, passing control and the result straight back. The executable does not name the function it reaches.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:add21k:0:07BA
name: forward_stored_library_call
description: Tiny wrapper that loads a library base from a stored pointer and jumps to one library function through its vector, passing control and the result straight back. The executable does not name the function it reaches.

name: forward_stored_library_call
description: Tiny wrapper that loads a library base from a stored pointer and jumps to one library function through its vector, passing control and the result straight back. The executable does not name the function it reaches.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0000
name: create_narrator_device_library
description: Entry routine for the narrator device file that builds its library structure, allocates memory and a signal, finds the current task, then adds the device and starts its task. It returns minus one on success and zero if the structure cannot be created.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:00D0
name: open_device_unit_request
description: Device open handler that, when the unit is already open, increments the open count and fills a request block with fixed setting values. For a new unit it opens the audio device and allocates a request block, returning a failure code if either step fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:00DE
name: open_audio_device_unit
description: Opens the audio device for the first unit, allocating a request block and returning a failure code if the open or the allocation fails. When the unit is already open, it only increments the open count and fills in the fixed request settings.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0110
name: create_named_command_port
description: Fills in a port structure named command port and registers it through a library call. On success it records the port and increments the open count, and on failure it sets an error code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:014E
name: set_request_defaults_and_count
description: Increments the unit open count and a request sequence counter, copies the sequence value into a request block, writes fixed default settings into it, and clears a flag bit in the device block.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01A0
name: set_request_status_byte
description: Stores a status byte into a request block and marks its completion field as minus one, then returns. Its only work is that single status update.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01AE
name: queue_request_with_interrupts_masked
description: Queues a request block onto the device's pending list, turning interrupts off while the list is changed and back on afterwards. When the list is empty or the request matches the head, it copies a nibble-split value from the device block instead.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01E0
name: insert_request_into_pending_list
description: Places a request block onto the device's pending list with interrupts disabled during the change. It is the insertion branch used when the request does not match the current head entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0222
name: update_or_insert_request_entry
description: Checks whether a request matches the current head entry and, if so, copies its nibble-split value across. Otherwise it links the request into the pending list while interrupts are disabled.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:026A
name: copy_byte_and_split_nibbles
description: Copies one byte from a source structure into a destination structure, storing it whole and as low and high nibbles in separate fields. It clears a status byte in the destination and then calls another routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0290
name: validate_and_apply_request_fields
description: Checks each numeric field of a request block against fixed ranges, such as a first range field from 1 to 400 and a second from 0 to 64, and copies the accepted values into the device state. Out-of-range values send it to an error path, and it manages the pending list with interrupts disabled.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:02F2
name: validate_request_ranges_and_apply
description: Applies the same range checks as its neighbouring routine, copying accepted range, flag and rate values into the device state. It then runs a completion path that releases resources when the pending flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:030C
name: close_unit_when_last_reference
description: Searches the pending list for a matching request and reduces the open count. When the count reaches zero it frees memory and closes the device, and it calls one more routine afterwards when a flag bit is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0332
name: decrement_counter_and_close
description: Decrements the unit's open count and, when it reaches zero, frees the memory block and closes the device. A flag bit then decides whether a further routine is called.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:036E
name: dispatch_request_by_command
description: Reads a command number from the request block. For values from 1 to 8 it jumps to the matching routine in a dispatch table, and for any other value it sets an error status and calls the error routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:038E
name: unlink_request_or_mark_busy
description: If a request block has no pending link, it unlinks the block from its list, frees it through the operating system, and returns the result. Otherwise it sets a busy flag bit in the block and returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:03AE
name: unlink_node_and_free_block
description: Calls two operating system library routines, unlinks a node by joining its neighbours, frees that memory, and returns a value taken from a field of the node.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:03F4
name: dispatch_narrator_request_command
description: Command dispatcher for the narrator device. It sets or clears busy flags for commands 1, 6, 7 and 8, links command 2 requests into the pending list, and passes other commands to a library call unless a busy flag is set, in which case it returns an error status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:046C
name: mark_command_seven_pending
description: Clears a busy flag in the request block, records command seven in the device block, sets a pending bit there, and makes a library call through the device base. It then clears a status byte in the request block.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:04A8
name: mark_command_six_pending
description: Clears a busy flag in the request block, records command six in the device block, sets a pending bit there, and makes a library call through the device base. It then clears a status byte in the request block.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:04E6
name: run_with_busy_flag_set
description: Sets bit seven of a status byte in a block, calls two other routines, then clears that bit again. It brackets the two calls with a busy marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0510
name: run_busy_then_clear_status
description: Sets bit seven of a status byte, calls a routine, clears that bit, then clears a status byte in a second block and calls a further routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0540
name: flush_pending_requests_masked
description: Calls a routine if the device has a current request, then walks the pending list and calls a routine for each entry, with interrupts turned off during the walk. It returns the result of the last call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0570
name: release_interrupt_lock
description: Decrements an interrupt nesting count held in a device byte, and when the count drops below one it turns interrupts back on. It undoes the interrupt-off step taken by the list routines.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0584
name: abort_pending_request
description: Turns interrupts off, then searches the pending list for a request block. If the block is the current head it marks it with a flag bit, otherwise it unlinks it and sets an error status, then turns interrupts back on.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05B0
name: remove_request_from_pending_list
description: Searches the pending list for a request block and, when it finds it, unlinks it and sets its status to an error value. It then reduces the interrupt nesting count, re-enabling interrupts when it reaches zero, and calls a further routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05BE
name: unlink_request_and_release_lock
description: Unlinks a request block from its list, sets its error status, reduces the interrupt nesting count and re-enables interrupts when the count drops below one, then calls one more routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05E8
name: release_interrupt_lock
description: Decrements an interrupt nesting count held in the device block and re-enables interrupts when the count drops below one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0600
name: set_error_status_then_call
description: Writes a specific error status into a request block and then calls one more routine. It is the failure exit taken when a request cannot be accepted.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:060C
name: set_success_status_then_call
description: Clears the status byte of a request block to zero and then calls one more routine. It is the normal completion exit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0616
name: clear_busy_flag_and_call
description: Clears a flag bit in the device block and a byte in the request block, then calls a library function through the device base. The executable does not name the library function it reaches.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0710
name: validate_request_fields_and_finish
description: Checks a request block's numeric, flag and rate fields against fixed ranges, copies accepted values into the device state, and runs the completion path. The completion path releases memory when a flag byte is set, and out-of-range values take the error path instead.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0744
name: validate_from_first_range_field
description: Entry point into the shared request validation chain at its first range field. It range-checks the value passed in the data register, stores it, then checks the remaining fields in order and runs the same completion path.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:075E
name: validate_from_second_range_field
description: Entry point into the shared request validation chain at its second range field. It range-checks the value passed in the data register, stores it, then checks the remaining fields in order and runs the same completion path.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:077E
name: validate_from_first_flag_field
description: Entry point into the shared request validation chain at a flag field. It stores the value passed in the data register without a range check, then checks the remaining fields in order and runs the same completion path.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0798
name: validate_from_second_flag_field
description: Entry point into the shared request validation chain at a second flag field. It stores the value passed in the data register without a range check, then checks the remaining fields in order and runs the same completion path.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:07AC
name: validate_from_rate_field
description: Entry point into the shared request validation chain at the rate field. It range-checks the value passed in the data register, stores it, then checks the remaining fields in order and runs the same completion path.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:07C6
name: validate_from_level_field
description: Entry point into the shared request validation chain at a field allowed from zero to 64. Values above 64 go straight to the completion path with an error status, while accepted values are stored and the remaining fields are checked in order.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0846
name: finish_request_and_release_memory
description: Completion path shared by the validation exits. It adjusts the task priority, releases memory when a flag byte is set, and passes the request result back through a status field.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:08E6
name: copy_field_and_set_status
description: Copies one longword from a source field into a destination field, stores the status byte passed in the data register, and calls one more routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:08EE
name: clear_field_and_set_status
description: Clears a longword field in a block, stores the status byte passed in the data register, and calls one more routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0900
name: search_text_for_punctuation_break
description: Searches backwards through a text buffer for the last comma or hyphen and records that position as the break point. If none is found it falls back to the space search, then continues the completion path.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0930
name: search_text_for_space_break
description: Searches backwards from about three quarters of a text buffer for a space and records that position as the break point. If no space is found it records the half-way point instead, then continues the completion path.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0956
name: record_half_length_break
description: Records the half-way point of a text buffer as the break position, then runs the completion path, which releases memory when a flag byte is set. It is the last-resort fallback of the break search.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0CF0
name: initialise_speech_request_block
description: Clears the counters of a speech request block and sets fixed starting values, then enters supervisor mode through the operating system. It allocates a message port named Speech IORB and a block for each handler, copying a template of thirty-three words into each block, and returns zero on success or a failure code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0D46
name: allocate_speech_block_from_template
description: Uses a value from the request block as an index into a handler table, allocates a named message port structure, and copies a thirty-three-word template into a newly allocated block. It returns zero on success and a failure code when a lookup or allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0D68
name: initialise_speech_port_and_signal
description: Initialises a supplied message port as a named speech request port and allocates a signal for it. It then looks up a handler for the index in the request block and copies a thirty-three-word template into a newly allocated block, returning zero on success or a failure code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0DBE
name: allocate_and_copy_template_rows
description: Stores a count byte in the request block, allocates a memory block, and copies a thirty-three-word template into each of several rows of it. It returns zero on success and a failure code when the allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0DDE
name: copy_template_into_rows
description: Stores a pointer in the request block and copies a thirty-three-word template into each of several rows at that pointer, repeating for a count held in a byte. It returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0E14
name: perform_io_and_release_blocks
description: Stores a mode byte in the request block, performs the I/O request synchronously, frees the memory blocks it owns, clears a length field, and returns a fixed combined value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0E24
name: perform_io_then_free_resources
description: Stores a mode byte in the request block, performs the I/O request synchronously, then frees a signal and the memory blocks it owns. It clears a length field and returns the combined value; it is the closing variant of the request routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0F68
name: translate_text_to_phonemes
description: Main text-to-phoneme translation loop. It returns early when the remaining length is below one, otherwise it clears its output buffers and steps through the input characters, looking each one up in a table of character classes and storing phoneme codes. It stops at a null or hash mark, or when the buffer fills, and sets flag bits for two special marker codes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0F72
name: translate_text_without_length_check
description: Same translation loop as its neighbour but without the initial length check. It clears the output buffers and steps through the input characters, storing phoneme codes and marker flags until the buffer fills or a null or hash mark ends the input.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0FE4
name: continue_phoneme_translation_loop
description: Re-enters the phoneme translation loop partway through, looking up the current input character in the character-class table and handling special marker codes before storing output. It returns the output position reached when the buffer limit or the end of the input is hit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0FF8
name: resume_phoneme_translation_scan
description: Resumes the phoneme translation scan at its end-of-word checks, where a zero or hash-mark character ends the scan and a numeric marker is converted to its digit character. Otherwise it passes control back into the main loop.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1026
name: resume_phoneme_translation_emit
description: Resumes the translation loop at the point where it writes the character class and checks the output buffer limit, then either returns or continues scanning the input.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1064
name: emit_phoneme_and_advance
description: Writes the phoneme code for the current input character into the output buffer, setting flag bits for two special marker codes, then either continues scanning or returns the output position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1074
name: set_marker_flag_then_scan
description: Re-enters the phoneme translation loop at a marker-six check, setting a flag bit on the previous output entry before scanning the next input character.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1084
name: store_output_character_and_check
description: Stores the current output character, advances the output position and checks the buffer limit. It then scans the next input character, or returns once the limit is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10AA
name: scan_next_input_character
description: Scans the next input character, looking it up in the character-class table and either emitting a code or converting a digit marker. It returns when the input ends, the remaining length is used up, or the buffer fills.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10C2
name: empty_return_stub
description: Routine that contains only a return, so it does nothing and ends immediately. It is entered from several places in the translator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10CC
name: finish_output_and_record_length
description: Trims or extends the last output entry, writes end markers into three output buffers, and records the input length consumed and the output count before returning.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10D8
name: append_end_markers_and_count
description: Adds an optional separator code after the last output entry when a table flag allows it, writes end markers into three output buffers, and records the consumed length and output count.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1122
name: record_output_count
description: Stores the output count passed in the data register into the translation state block. It is a single store with no other work.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:112C
name: propagate_stress_markers
description: Walks the phoneme output list up to its end marker and, for each entry whose class flags allow it, sets an emphasis bit on that entry and on the entries before it. How far the bit spreads depends on the classes of the earlier entries and whether they are zero-digit markers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:118E
name: propagate_stress_markers_loop
description: Loop body of the stress-propagation pass. It applies a second class-flag test before stepping through the phoneme list and setting emphasis bits on earlier entries, returning at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:119E
name: propagate_stress_markers_entry
description: Alternative entry into the stress-propagation pass that applies a class-flag test to the previous entry before stepping through the phoneme list. It sets emphasis bits on earlier entries and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:11BC
name: propagate_phoneme_flags_forward
description: Walks the phoneme list and sets a marker bit on each entry, copying stress and emphasis bits from the entry before it into a run of following entries when a class flag applies. It finishes when it reaches the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:121A
name: propagate_flags_over_span
description: Continuation of the phoneme flag pass that fills a span of entries with a value derived from the preceding phoneme, then resumes scanning the list until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1262
name: fill_span_flag_values
description: Fills the entries of a span with a flag value derived from the phoneme before it, then resumes the scan of the phoneme list until the end marker or a stop code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12CC
name: fill_span_flags_fragment
description: Decodes as an unreached stretch that repeats the span-filling step of the flag pass, so its behaviour matches the neighbouring fill routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12D6
name: empty_return_stub
description: Routine that contains only a return, so it does nothing and ends immediately.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12D8
name: match_text_rules_against_input
description: Scans a table of translation entries, each holding a pattern of up to three characters with wildcards and a pair of output codes. When the input around the current position matches an entry, it applies that entry's output codes and moves on, and it stops at the end-of-table marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1324
name: continue_rule_pattern_match
description: Continues the pattern-matching scan at the characters after the current pattern, checking the neighbouring input character against the entry's wildcard pattern. A match applies the entry's output, and a miss moves on to the next table entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13C2
name: advance_rule_pattern_scan
description: Resumes the pattern-matching loop after an output step, checking for the end-of-table marker and advancing to the next table entry when the pattern does not fit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13D6
name: scan_rule_table_entries
description: Re-enters the pattern-matching loop at its scan step, testing each table entry's three-character pattern against the input and, on a match, applying the entry's output codes before scanning on.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13E4
name: test_rule_condition_bits
description: Loops over a condition byte and a table word indexed by a counter, inverting or masking the word according to two flag bits in the byte. It stops when a chosen bit is set in the combined value or when the end marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1412
name: insert_shift_three_buffers
description: Increments a word counter while it is below its limit, then shifts the bytes of three parallel buffers one place to the right from a given position. It writes a byte from a data register into the freed slot of the first buffer and zeros into the other two.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1428
name: shift_three_buffers_and_clear
description: Increments a word counter and shifts bytes backward through three parallel buffers by a computed count. It then writes a byte from a register into the first buffer's freed slot and zeros into the other two.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1454
name: call_seven_routines_return_zero
description: Calls seven other routines in turn and returns zero. It is a fixed sequence of calls with no logic of its own.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1472
name: clear_table_flags_mark_end
description: Walks a table of eight-byte entries until the end marker, clearing the last byte of each entry. It then sets that byte in the final entry to a fixed marker value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:148A
name: clear_table_flags_until_match
description: Clears the last byte of each eight-byte table entry until it reaches an entry whose first byte matches the value passed in the data register. It then sets that entry's last byte to a fixed marker value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1492
name: process_phoneme_entry_values
description: Walks the phoneme list and writes per-entry values. Entries with one special code take a value combined from the two preceding entries and halved, entries with a class flag get a stored output byte from a lookup table, and other flagged entries get a flag bit set. It finishes at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:14B2
name: process_phoneme_entries_inline
description: Inline variant of the phoneme entry pass, with the same special-code, lookup and flag steps, running until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:14E6
name: process_phoneme_entries_alternate
description: Alternative entry into the phoneme entry pass. It handles flagged entries first, then the special-code step, and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1510
name: process_phoneme_entries_bit_entry
description: Entry into the phoneme entry pass that takes a flag value directly from the data register, applies the lookup step, then loops over the remaining entries until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1558
name: set_class_flag_and_continue
description: Sets a flag bit on the current output entry according to two class bits in the data register, then continues the phoneme entry pass with the next entry. It returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1564
name: set_class_flag_then_scan
description: Sets one of two class flag bits on the current output entry according to one bit of a flag value, then scans forward through the phoneme list, handling special codes and returning at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1572
name: set_class_flag_from_bits
description: Sets a default class flag on the current output entry, then chooses one of several class flags from bits in the next entry's flag value. It continues the phoneme entry pass until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:157C
name: continue_phoneme_entry_scan
description: Scans the phoneme entry list from the current position, copying each entry's lookup byte to the output and applying class flags. It handles the special-code step and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1586
name: allocate_phoneme_output_tables
description: Adds up the values in a phoneme flag table until its end marker, stores the total and the size needed for the output table, then allocates memory for the output. When a flag byte is set it allocates a second block as well.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15A0
name: allocate_output_tables_for_count
description: Stores a count and the output size derived from it, allocates a block for the output table, and when a flag byte is set allocates a second one. It returns early if an allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15C2
name: allocate_secondary_output_table
description: Stores a block address passed in the data register, and when a flag byte is set allocates a second memory block for the output. It returns early if that allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15E0
name: build_phoneme_frame_table
description: Builds the output frame table. For each phoneme it looks up values in several tables, adjusts them with the stress bits, and writes one eight-byte record per frame for the phoneme's duration. Where a flag byte is set it also writes a second per-frame value, and the table ends with a run of end-marker bytes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:160A
name: build_phoneme_frame_table_alternate
description: Alternative frame-table builder with the same per-phoneme lookups, stress adjustment and eight-byte frame records. It ends the table with a run of end-marker bytes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:16B8
name: build_phoneme_frames_with_lookbehind
description: Frame-table builder that writes eight-byte records per phoneme as the other builders do. For special codes one and two it takes the look-behind value from the preceding input byte, and it finishes with end-marker bytes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:172A
name: interpolate_frame_values
description: Interpolates six values across each run of frame records, moving each value toward the next entry's value by a weight taken from the phoneme's table. It skips some special codes and finishes at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1762
name: interpolate_frame_values_loop
description: Continues the frame interpolation pass, moving six values toward the next entry's values by a weight taken from the phoneme table. It advances through the frame list and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:177A
name: interpolate_frame_values_alternate
description: Alternative interpolation pass over the frame list, moving each value toward its neighbour by a weight from the phoneme table. It skips records that carry a special code and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17A8
name: interpolate_frame_values_tail
description: Interpolation step that works through a run of frame records, computing each value from its neighbours and a weight, and stops at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17D2
name: interpolate_frame_values_step
description: Single interpolation step that moves one frame value toward its neighbour by the weight in the table, advancing to the next record when the count runs out.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17D6
name: write_phoneme_frame_records
description: Writes frame records for the phoneme list, using each phoneme's class bits to decide how many frames to emit and what value to store in each. It handles the special codes that change the frame count and returns the number of frames written.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:181E
name: write_frame_records_from_offset
description: Alternative frame-record writer that starts from the current frame pointer and writes zeroed records for each phoneme's duration, with fill bytes when a flag is set. It ends when the phoneme list reaches its end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1844
name: write_frame_records_tail
description: Tail variant of the frame-record writer that fills zeroed records for a phoneme's span, then loads the next phoneme's class bits. It returns zero at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:186E
name: write_frame_records_entry
description: Entry into the frame-record writer that starts from the first phoneme's lookup value, writes the span of frame records, and returns zero at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1880
name: write_frame_records_with_stress
description: Frame-record writer variant that sets a stress-related class value from the following phoneme and writes records for each phoneme's span until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:18B8
name: write_frame_records_with_flags
description: Frame-record writer that checks the class flags of the current phoneme and writes records for its span, using the following phoneme's flags to fill the remaining entries. It returns zero at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:190E
name: write_frame_records_fill_value
description: Writes zeroed frame records for each phoneme's span, using a fill value from the data register for the flag bytes when the entry is not marked. It loops over the phoneme list until the end marker and returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:191A
name: write_frame_records_from_pointer
description: Writes a counted run of zeroed frame records, then writes the spans for each following phoneme, returning zero at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:193A
name: write_frame_records_counted
description: Writes a counted run of zeroed frame records, then walks the phoneme list and writes a span for each entry until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1946
name: write_frame_records_after_first
description: Writes one zeroed frame record, then a counted run of records for the remaining phoneme span, and returns zero at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1966
name: write_frame_records_by_count
description: Writes frame records for the phoneme list using a count taken from each entry's class bits, and returns zero at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1970
name: filter_phoneme_entries
description: Copies the phoneme list into three output arrays, skipping any entry whose class word has one particular flag bit set, and terminates the copy with end-marker bytes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19B0
name: write_byte_to_three_pointers
description: Writes the same byte from a data register into three memory locations, one each through three address registers. It is a triple store with no other work.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19BC
name: call_two_routines_then_return
description: Calls two other routines in turn and returns. It has no logic of its own.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19C4
name: mark_phoneme_run_boundaries
description: Clears the low nibble of each entry in one output array, then walks the phoneme list marking run boundaries by setting flag bits on the first entry of each run and on the last entry before the next run. It finishes at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19D8
name: mark_phoneme_run_boundaries_alt
description: Alternative entry into the run-boundary marking pass, with the same flag steps as its neighbour but without clearing the low nibbles first. It finishes at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19F2
name: mark_run_boundaries_loop
description: Loop variant of the run-boundary marking pass. It walks the phoneme list, setting boundary flags on entries as it goes, and repeats until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A24
name: mark_run_boundaries_tail
description: Tail of the run-boundary marking pass. It sets flags on the current entry, then scans forward and marks the next run boundary, returning at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A48
name: mark_run_boundaries_scan
description: Scans forward through the phoneme list from the current entry, setting boundary flags on the entries that begin and end each run. It returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A72
name: mark_run_boundaries_inner
description: Inner loop of the run-boundary pass that marks each run's final entry and then resumes scanning the list. It returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A78
name: mark_run_boundaries_pair
description: Sets a pair of boundary flags on the previous entries, then runs the boundary scan until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A8E
name: compute_phoneme_frame_periods
description: Converts a rate value into a period by dividing a fixed constant by it, then walks the phoneme list and writes per-frame period values, interpolating between each phoneme's neighbouring values. When the mode value is one, it writes a single value for every entry instead.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1AF0
name: write_phoneme_periods_from_stored
description: Writes per-frame period values for each phoneme using the period already stored in the block, interpolating between neighbouring entries. It finishes at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B00
name: write_interpolated_frame_periods
description: Writes per-frame values for each phoneme by dividing the stored period by each frame's table value and interpolating between neighbouring frames. It ends with a final value at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B34
name: interpolate_period_values_loop
description: Loop that interpolates per-frame period values between neighbouring frames, stepping through the phoneme list and writing a value at each boundary. It ends when the end marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B48
name: interpolate_period_values_tail
description: Tail of the period-interpolation pass. It writes the boundary value for the current run, then steps through the remaining entries and writes the final value at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BB4
name: interpolate_period_values_run
description: Interpolates period values across a run of frames, writing each boundary value from the stored period divided by a per-frame value, and loops until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BCA
name: write_constant_period_values
description: Divides the stored period by a fixed divisor and writes the result into the first byte of each eight-byte record until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BE4
name: empty_return_stub
description: Routine that contains only a return, so it does nothing and ends immediately.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BE8
name: apply_frame_adjustments
description: Walks the frame records and adjusts each frame's value by offsets chosen from the class bits of the neighbouring phonemes, skipping special codes. Each result is capped at 63 before it is stored, and the routine returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C22
name: adjust_frame_values_by_class
description: Applies class-based offsets to each frame value using the neighbouring phonemes' class bits, then caps the stored value at 63. It returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C3A
name: adjust_frame_values_tail
description: Tail of the frame-value adjustment pass that applies the same class offsets to the current frame, caps the stored value at 63, and then steps to the next entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C42
name: adjust_frame_values_loop
description: Loop variant of the frame-value adjustment pass. It applies class offsets to each frame, caps each stored value at 63, and repeats until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CBA
name: adjust_frame_values_neighbour_pass
description: Frame-value adjustment pass that chooses an offset from the class bits of the phonemes either side, applies it, and caps the stored value at 63. It continues through the list until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CD2
name: adjust_frame_values_neighbour_step
description: Single neighbour-dependent adjustment step for the frame values. It applies the chosen offset, caps the stored value at 63, and moves on to the next phoneme.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CE2
name: adjust_frame_values_neighbour_loop
description: Loop variant of the neighbour-dependent adjustment pass. It applies offsets from the surrounding class bits to each frame, caps the stored values at 63, and repeats until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CFC
name: adjust_frame_values_neighbour_tail
description: Tail of the neighbour-dependent adjustment pass. It applies the remaining class-bit offsets to the current frame, caps the stored value at 63, and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1D0C
name: adjust_frame_values_neighbour_scan
description: Scans forward through the frame list applying neighbour-dependent offsets and the 63 cap to each stored value. It returns when the end marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1D8A
name: adjust_frame_values_pair_flags
description: Compares flag bits of the neighbouring phonemes before adjusting the current frame value, caps the result at 63, and then moves to the next entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1DA4
name: adjust_frame_values_final_pass
description: Final frame-value adjustment loop. It calls a routine for each entry, applies neighbour-dependent offsets, caps the stored value at 63, and keeps going until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1DAC
name: adjust_frame_values_class_loop
description: Frame-value adjustment pass that applies offsets from neighbouring class bits, caps the stored values at 63, and loops until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1E12
name: scale_product_with_rounding
description: Multiplies the low word of one register by a word from another, then returns the high word of the product together with the low word after adding sixteen and shifting right by five.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1E1C
name: initialise_block_pointers_and_clear
description: Stores a set of pointer offsets into the block structure from its base, sets several word fields to zero, and clears six blocks of thirty-two longwords each.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1EE0
name: advance_frame_counter_and_call
description: Increments a frame counter word in the block and always calls one routine. It calls four more routines only while the counter has neither wrapped nor reached zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F02
name: collect_marked_frame_entries
description: Walks the frame list and writes a compact value for each phoneme frame, marking entries that carry class flags. It stops at 128 entries or the end marker, and records the entry count and the first and last marked positions in the block.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F58
name: collect_marked_frame_entries_loop
description: Loop variant of the frame-entry collection pass. It writes a compact value per frame, marks entries that carry class flags, stops at 128 entries or the end marker, and records the entry count and the marked positions.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F76
name: collect_marked_frame_entries_alt
description: Alternative frame-entry collection pass with the same compact values, class marking and 128-entry limit. It records the count and the first and last marked positions when it returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1FC0
name: mark_last_frame_entry
description: Sets a boundary flag on the last written frame entry, then records that entry's position and the first marked position in the block.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1FD8
name: assign_frame_entry_flags
description: Walks the marked frame entries from the end and assigns flag values according to their class codes. Special codes two, four and fourteen are handled separately, and the resulting flags are written into a second array.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2010
name: propagate_frame_entry_flags
description: Propagates the assigned frame entry flags back through the preceding entries, copying each value to the nearest slot that carries a particular class bit. It stops at the start of the marked list.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2032
name: propagate_frame_entry_flags_loop
description: Loop variant of the flag propagation pass. It writes boundary flags on marked entries and copies flag values to earlier entries, returning when the start of the list is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2054
name: propagate_frame_entry_flags_tail
description: Tail of the flag propagation pass. It saves the list positions, then walks the flags back from the end of the marked list and returns when it reaches the start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:206C
name: propagate_frame_flag_values_back
description: Walks the marked frame entries backwards, copying a flag value into the nearest qualifying slot and clearing the source slot when the two positions differ.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:208E
name: copy_flag_to_nearest_slot
description: Searches outwards from the current frame entry for the nearest slot with a particular flag bit and copies the flag value there, clearing the source entry when it moves. It returns once the start of the list is passed.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20A8
name: swap_and_clear_byte_flags
description: Copies a flag byte from a source slot to a destination slot in a table, clearing the source when the slots differ, then walks backwards through the marked entries applying the same copy until the start of the list.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a2]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a2].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20BC
name: set_low_flag_across_range
description: Sets the lowest bit of each byte in a block, counting down from a size passed in a word register. It writes the flag across the whole range and returns.
